liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Douai, Bibliothèque municipale, MS 67 (formerly 94/6), from Marchiennes
liebermann.notes: A 12th-century pontifical, described at Marchiennes in the 18th century as a gift of Thomas Becket, copied from an English text of the late 11th century; it contains the Sacramentum coronationis and Iudicium Dei X and XIV, and also an Iudicium ferri.
